conventions.layerName: Paper layer name is canonical. Variants use a dot suffix (OBSetRow.done). A block may map to a shared widget or an inline composition; the Dart owner need not match the Paper name.
conventions.canonical: The node on the Bausteine page is canonical. Screens contain clones; a visual change is made on the Bausteine node first, then re-applied to the widget, then screens are re-derived.
conventions.package: Existing ui2 code is reused — not every Paper block is a class in lib/openband. implementationStatus is explicit when the block is not in source; absent status means implemented when file and widget resolve.
conventions.honesty: Absent input renders as — or is omitted. Partial totals are labeled; no ≥ prefix or invented length for unknown amounts. Progress requires an actual saved target.
conventions.sourceCheck: tool/check_design_manifest.py verifies that implemented file/widget references exist in source. It does not verify routing or visual acceptance.

blocks.name: OBPageHeader.detail

Exercise detail reuses the optional trailing action for Lucide copy, with the Kopieren accessibility label; copied definitions return to the same library unselected. blocks.name: OBMetricCard
blocks.notes: Borderless card, radius24, padding14, minimum112; value/unit share a baseline and stack only when needed. Null omits the unit. Compact typed night states remain visible; comparison requires current complete data and an explicitly trusted stored baseline. No invented range marker or comparison arrow. Optional decimal precision preserves respiration values and baseline deltas; default integer formatting stays unchanged. Temperature uses typed SD or Celsius and signed SD formatting; unknown quantities show — without a unit.

blocks.name: OBStatusChip

blocks.name: OBTrendCard

blocks.name: OBTrendPlot
blocks.notes: Baseline band, dotted mean, polyline, dashed gap marker, endpoint dot. Two axis labels only. Plot is inline in OBTrendCard via _TrendPainter; no OBTrendPlot type. Scalar baseline is a line, never an invented range band.

blocks.name: OBSettingsGroup

blocks.name: OBSettingsRow

blocks.name: OBCalendar
blocks.notes: Shared Monday-first44-point calendar. Sleep selection retains night dots and disables future days; goal dates enable future days and omit metric dots. Canonical future variant3WKQ-0. Paper header, fonts and cell insets reconciled to shared native44-point controls; adjacent-month cells remain empty. Export calendar-native-parity-jsx.json. Optional lastDate caps civil-day selection and forward month navigation independently of the real today marker; allowFuture=false also retains the today cap. Weight uses min(selected day, today), no availability dots, and a year-1 previous-month guard.

blocks.name: OBDayPreview

blocks.name: OBSyncState

blocks.name: OBStepsHours

blocks.name: OBMetricHero
blocks.note: Stored nightly HRV/RHR scalar, unit and honest state; no invented range. Comparison only for an explicitly trusted stored baseline. Correction-pending or unproven values remain behind Info.

blocks.name: OBNightBars
blocks.note: Actual stored nights in a civil 7/30/90-day window, anchored to the selected stored algorithm. Explicit gaps; actual scalar baseline line. No interpolation, invented spread band or decorative gap markers. Seven-night bars are14px wide (rounded7px ends);30-night bars remain6px and90-night bars fit their actual calendar slots. Missing nights keep their slots.

blocks.name: OBNoticeCard

blocks.name: OBPairCard

blocks.name: OBTrendPlot.night

blocks.name: OBNapRow

blocks.name: OBTimeField.well
blocks.notes: Shared controller-backed time field; paired wells stack when text needs more width.

blocks.name: OBSettingsRow.value
blocks.notes: Shared value/navigation row. Compact notification metrics unchanged; comfortable goal variant uses64 minimum,14/20 padding,15/20 label and card-radius ink. Empty-value large-text label wraps beside chevron. Long values wrap at normal and large text; empty choices remain explicit. Empty-value navigation rows keep a fixed trailing chevron at all text scales; value-bearing rows retain the shared large-text stacked layout. Leading icon variant uses a36-point fixed tile,12-point label gap and56-point normal minimum. Existing compact/comfortable variants retain their layout. Leading value–chevron gap is12; existing non-leading gap remains4. Optional source/date subtitle wraps. Dated journal-weight entries use this same row, with regular date and medium muted value; large text follows the canonical stack.

blocks.name: OBSettingsChoiceSheet
blocks.notes: Canonical generic choice sheet shared by notification thresholds and explicit exercise equipment, capture mode, load and repetition basis; selected choice only, fixed check lane. Canonical bottom padding includes20 points plus the device safe area; native cycle-gap chooser verified at375/393px and2x text.

blocks.name: OBTimePicker
blocks.notes: Shared stock input-only time dialog with Alpin card/well/ink, 296×264 at1x and112×72 fields. Platform locale/24h and accessible input retained; no dial. Invalid entry stays open; cancellation returns no change.

blocks.name: OBSettingsChoiceRow

blocks.name: OBSetupStatusCard
blocks.notes: Three independent source facts: connection, stored frontier and current-local-day evaluation. Shared48 minimum rows,20 icon lane,12 gap,15 labels/values. Current job failure/pending remains separate from successful recalculation. Native acceptance is recorded separately.

blocks.name: OBConfirmSheet
blocks.notes: Shared discard/remove sheet; optional short body explains which dated target boundary will change. Close/cancel retain draft. Paper canonical and Journal/goal clones reconciled to source:32% scrim and12px content bottom plus34px example safe area; no Flutter confirmation behavior changed.

blocks.name: OBSleepNeedSummary
blocks.notes: Stored coming-night forecast only; current civil day and algorithm envelope, exact input-read provenance, served-row and pending-job freshness. Unknowns, partial contributions and stale data remain explicit. No prior-night attainment.

blocks.name: OBSleepSchedule
blocks.notes: Stored bedtime estimate and typical wake time; no alarm mutation or cycle-alignment claim. Missing times stay absent. Large text stacks the same two values.

blocks.name: OBAdaptiveValues
blocks.notes: One shared pair for Overview, Sleep and Health. Equal-width row with10gap; full-width vertical cards when scaled14px text exceeds20px. Preserves values and supports large text without shrinking.

blocks.name: OBCalendarLine
blocks.notes: Shared calendar-slot numeric line for stored temperature and the explicitly labelled journal-weight EWMA. Consecutive finite slots connect directly; actual gaps stay empty. Callers select signed zero-centered SD or absolute kilograms/Celsius. No metric computation or unit inference. Measured scaled labels set the gutter; existing temperature geometry is preserved when labels fit.
